knownVisibleProblems.problem: Kira's face is mostly hidden by her own black side-hair block; the warning expression does not read. The speaker-OTS camera passed because the camera evaluator counts an actor's own head parts (incl. side hair) as never occluding her face.
Zapp's head/body is cut at the left frame edge. He is an optional supporting actor there, and optional actors are not crop-checked in single-character coverage.

knownVisibleProblems.at: 44.22-49.50 s (p10: "taller than the desk, wider than Zapp, almost fills the entire room")
knownVisibleProblems.problem: The coin is mostly off screen while the narration describes its size: s026 shows Zapp and Kira without the coin, s027 shows it only partly at the left edge, s028 shows Kira alone.

knownVisibleProblems.at: 51.47-54.70 s (p11-c02: "Kira has already moved safely out of the way")
knownVisibleProblems.problem: The picture stays on Zapp; Kira is not shown during the line about her.
The tip and flattening read, but the action is small in a distant wide shot (upper-middle third of the frame).
During "flattens Zapp against the classroom floor" the camera shows Kira walking; the flattened Zapp is off screen apart from the coin edge at the bottom.
The narration says the button flashes, but the insert shows only the small coin.
Near-identical coin framings about one second apart.
Zapp's reaction is shot from above; his face is foreshortened and the shock only partly reads.
A 3.9 s near-static very tight close on Kira (head fills the frame width).
The lower-band caption covers the "FREE COINS" label on the button base.
Draft only: no lip-sync, software-GL shading at 540x960, blocky placeholder faces.
